# Masterclass: Agentic Software Engineering using Claude Code

Great software no longer has to cost a fortune or consume every hour of your day. With Claude Code, you get an engineering partner that plans, builds, tests, and ships alongside you at a fraction of the time and cost. This isn't about prompting an AI. It's about designing systems that multiply what you can deliver. Welcome to the new standard.

Agentic software engineering is a discipline shift, and once you experience it, there's no going back. Instead of spending days on tasks that take agents minutes, you orchestrate workflows that reduce cost, eliminate repetition, and scale your output without scaling your team. The developers who master this don't just move faster. They do more with less, and they do it consistently.

Across 14 hands-on modules, you'll go from Claude Code fundamentals to production-grade multi-agent pipelines. You'll design composable skills, build MCP tools that connect agents to real systems, architect parallel sub-agent workflows, and harden everything for real-world conditions. Every module is built around genuine engineering decisions, because the goal was never to write more code. It was always to build software that matters.


| Module | Description |
| ------ | ----------- |
| [01 Fundamentals](/demos/01-fundamentals/readme.md) | Claude product family, installation and authentication, context engineering with CLAUDE.md |
| [02 Harness](/demos/02-harness/readme.md) | Settings hierarchy, custom slash commands, and event-driven hooks |
| [03 Skills](/demos/03-skills/readme.md) | Skill anatomy, invocation model, authoring by hand and from a conversation |
| [04 MCP](/demos/04-mcp/readme.md) | MCP architecture, connecting remote endpoints, wrapping REST APIs as servers |
| [05 CLI](/demos/05-cli/readme.md) | Headless `-p` runs, tool scoping, parallel isolation, and long-running goal patterns |
| [06 Sub-agents](/demos/06-subagents/readme.md) | Sub-agent frontmatter, tool restriction, and orchestrator decomposition patterns |
| [07 Agent Teams](/demos/07-agent-teams/readme.md) | Lead, teammates, shared task list and mailbox, and where a team beats a sub-agent |
| [08 Optimize](/demos/08-optimize/readme.md) | Token cost, caveman compression, and the autoresearch promote/revert loop |
| [09 Observability](/demos/09-observability/readme.md) | Prompt injection, permission hardening, and observability as a design constraint |
| [10 Distribution](/demos/10-distribution/readme.md) | Plugin manifests, converting a `.claude/` config, and marketplace catalogs |
| [11 Agentic DevOps](/demos/11-agentic-devops/readme.md) | Containerized deploy to a plain Ubuntu host over SSH, with the agent proving the result |
| [12 Managed Agents](/demos/12-managed-agents/readme.md) | Cloud containers, mid-execution steering via SSE, OAuth vaults and token refresh |
| [13 Agent SDK](/demos/13-claude-sdk/readme.md) | The `query()` async iterator, session resume, custom tools, and typed output with Zod |
| [14 Planning](/demos/14-planning/readme.md) | Optional. Plan Mode mechanics, decomposition, and independently verifiable sub-agent packages |
